cuts.head: with_body
cuts.placeText: a pottery studio — a spinning wheel, shelves of drying pots, glaze buckets and a kiln in the back
cuts.scene: she is an apprentice at the wheel with a lump of clay, wobbling her first pot
cuts.outfit: a potter look fitted to her body — a clay-stained apron over a fitted tank top and short shorts, bare shoulders and legs, a plain white headscarf
